title: DE-4/2022/P2 - Departmental Examination for Junior Members of I.A.S., I.P.S. and I.F.S. - December, 2021 - Special and Local Laws (With Books)
questions: 1. Define the following terms with relevant laws and sections. (a) Adolescent offender
1(b) Powers of police officer on occasion of fire
2. Discuss the law governing preservation of wild elephants under the Kerala Forest Act, 1961.
3. Discuss the law relating to release of an adolescent offender on license. When can the license be forfeited?
4. What are the main duties of Police Officers under Kerala Police Act, 1960?
5. Discuss the procedure to be followed for levy of tax under the Kerala Motor Vehicle Taxation Act, 1976.
6. What are the entertainments exempted from payment of tax under the Kerala Gaming Act, 1960? What is the manner of payment of tax under the Act?
7. Elucidate the power of Government to restrict movements of registered offenders.
8. Define "Objectionable performance" under Kerala Dramatic Performances Act, 1961. Explain the procedure and conditions for regulating objectionable performance under the Act.
9. Who is "Delinquent Child"? What procedure is to be followed when a delinquent child is produced before Children's Court? What orders can be passed against a delinquent child and what not?
